# Segmented

> An animated segmented control for React and shadcn, for picking one option from a few.

- Docs and live demo: https://eased.dev/components/segmented?ref=context7
- Source: [src/registry/eased/segmented/](../../src/registry/eased/segmented/)
- Installs: `components/eased/segmented/segmented.tsx`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react`, `motion`

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn add @eased/segmented
```

Or by URL:

```bash
npx shadcn add https://eased.dev/r/segmented.json
```

Import paths below assume the default `@/components` alias in `components.json`.

A single-choice control with a gliding thumb, on Base UI's RadioGroup: one tab stop, arrow keys move the selection, Home/End, and form submission through `name`.

## When to use

- Picking one of two to five short options that change a value: a date range, a view density, a billing period.
- Filters and settings where every option should stay visible, so people see what they are not choosing.
- Inside forms: it submits its value through `name` like a radio group.

## When not to use

- Swapping regions of content: use [Tabs](https://eased.dev/components/tabs?ref=context7), which wire up panels.
- More than five options, or long labels: use a [Radio Group](https://eased.dev/components/radio-group?ref=context7) or a select.
- Options that can be on at the same time: use [Toggle Group](https://eased.dev/components/toggle-group?ref=context7).

## Usage

```tsx date-range.tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Segmented } from "@/components/eased/segmented/segmented";

export function DateRange() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState("30d");
  return (
    <Segmented
      aria-label="Date range"
      options={[
        { value: "7d", label: "7 days" },
        { value: "30d", label: "30 days" },
        { value: "12m", label: "12 mo" },
      ]}
      value={range}
      onValueChange={setRange}
    />
  );
}
```

## Examples

### Icon-only segments

Each icon-only segment needs its own `aria-label`.

```tsx
<Segmented
  aria-label="Layout"
  options={[
    { value: "list", icon: <ListIcon />, "aria-label": "List" },
    { value: "grid", icon: <GridIcon />, "aria-label": "Grid" },
  ]}
  defaultValue="list"
/>
```

### Full width in a form

`fullWidth` splits the container equally; `size="md"` matches 36px form fields.

```tsx
<Segmented name="billing" size="md" fullWidth aria-label="Billing period" options={periods} defaultValue="yearly" />
```

## API reference

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `{ value, label?, icon?, "aria-label"?, disabled? }[]` | | Icon-only segments need an `aria-label`. |
| `value` / `defaultValue` | `V` | first option | Controlled or uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: V) => void` | | |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | `"sm"` | 32px for dense UI and headers, 36px for forms and settings. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Fill the container and split it equally. |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits the value with a form. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | | |
| `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` | `string` | | Name the group. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| `Tab` | Moves focus to the selected segment; the whole control is one tab stop. |
| `←` / `→` | Selects the previous or next segment. |
| `Home` / `End` | Selects the first or last segment. |

## Accessibility

- Base UI renders a `radiogroup` of `radio`s, so screen readers announce the group's name, the option and its position.
- Name the group with `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at a visible label.
- Labels only darken when selected; they never change weight, so the segments keep their width.

## Motion

The thumb glides to the new segment on the snappy spring and stays concentric with the track: its radius is the track's minus the padding and border. Reduced motion jumps the thumb to the new segment with no glide.

## Notes for AI

Use Segmented for a short, visible single choice that sets a value, controlled with `value` and `onValueChange` or submitted with `name`. Keep labels to one or two words; switch to `size="md"` beside form fields.

Do not use it to switch views (that is Tabs), and do not add your own thumb, indicator or selected-weight styles: the component draws the thumb and keeps it concentric.

## Related

- [Tabs](https://eased.dev/components/tabs?ref=context7): switches a region of content.
- [Toggle Group](https://eased.dev/components/toggle-group?ref=context7): several options on at once.
- [Radio Group](https://eased.dev/components/radio-group?ref=context7): longer lists and labels.
